thesis: Chris Dixon explains that he joined a16z as an angel investor and blogger because the firm was looking for someone with a track record, and he eventually helped build the firm's dedicated crypto practice. He traces his career arc from writing high-performance algorithms for Monte Carlo simulations at a quant trading firm to founding an internet security company and an AI company before leading a major round for Oculus and making early investments in Coinbase.
